question: Does one independently motivated, prospectively fixed cross-sectional 60-session price-momentum factor contain reproducible positive 5-session forward ranking information across a point-in-time liquid crypto perpetual universe after strict causal timing, support, dependence-aware inference and temporal/regime robustness, without factor selection or result-informed rescue?
hypothesis: Assets with stronger trailing 60-session return at weekly decision time will on average rank above weaker trailing-return assets over the next fully matured 5 sessions, with positive ranking information that remains stable across time and broad BTC market states.
economic_mechanism: Gradual information diffusion, persistent capital flows, heterogeneous investor updating and slow portfolio rebalancing can generate cross-sectional return continuation.
stopping_rule: Use PROSPECTIVE_FIVE_GATE_LIFECYCLE_V1. SPEC_FREEZE precedes controlled values; BUILD uses synthetic/nonhistorical fixtures only; ARM binds exact controlled identities and source-qualified interface; RUN consumes at most one authorized attempt through ControlledResearchRunnerV1SourceQualified; SEAL performs no scientific recomputation. No same-ID rerun, retune, rescue, source substitution, candidate replacement or history extension after marker durability.
success_criteria: At least 104 valid weekly IC observations.
Moving-block-bootstrap 95% lower bound for mean weekly IC >0.
At least 3/4 chronological blocks have mean IC >0 and none has mean IC <=-0.025.
At least 3 calendar years each have >=20 valid weekly observations and positive mean IC.
BTC_UP and BTC_NONUP each have >=30 observations and positive mean IC.
Every eligible leave-one-calendar-year-out mean IC remains >0.
All identity, causality, finite-statistic, read, candidate, persistence, source-interface and exactly-once invariants pass.
failure_criteria: Valid execution with sufficient support but any frozen G1-G8 scientific gate failing produces FAIL_NO_ROBUST_MOM60_FACTOR.
Valid execution with insufficient frozen support produces INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT.

Any source identity, manifest/hash, schema, timestamp, point-in-time membership, read-count, candidate-count, non-finite, persistence, network, marker-ordering, source-interface or exactly-once violation produces INVALID_EXECUTION.
allowed_followup: Only immutable PASS_VALIDATED_MOM60_FACTOR may make this exact factor eligible for a separately governed future Factor L/S research ID.
PASS may also motivate separately preregistered forward-only validation.
forbidden_followup: No inheritance of factor results or lifecycle credit from 0075 or 0084.

Use Monday UTC-close decisions and fully matured 5-session forward returns.
Use point-in-time top-30 trailing-30-session median quote-volume eligibility with minimum 120 completed daily sessions and minimum cross-section size 10.
Use mean weekly Spearman IC as primary statistic, MBB block length 8, 10000 replicates, seed 860086, and frozen G0-G9 gates.
